home.q: What is SEO and why does my business in Nepal need it?
home.a: SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is the process of optimizing your website to rank higher on Google and other search engines. For businesses in Nepal, SEO is crucial because over 90% of online experiences begin with a search engine. Ranking on the first page means more visibility, more traffic, and ultimately more customers — without paying for ads.

home.q: How long does SEO take to show results in Nepal?
home.a: SEO is a long-term strategy. Most businesses start seeing noticeable improvements in rankings within 3–6 months. However, for competitive keywords in Nepal (like 'hotel in Kathmandu' or 'trekking company Nepal'), it may take 6–12 months to achieve top rankings. We provide monthly reports so you can track progress every step of the way.

home.q: How much does SEO cost in Nepal?
home.a: Our SEO packages start from NPR 15,000/month for our Starter plan, which is ideal for small local businesses. Our Growth plan is NPR 30,000/month and our Enterprise plan is NPR 60,000/month. The right package depends on your goals, competition, and the number of target keywords.

home.q: Do you guarantee #1 rankings on Google?
home.a: No reputable SEO agency can guarantee specific rankings, as Google's algorithm is constantly evolving. However, we can guarantee a significant improvement in your rankings, traffic, and leads using proven, white-hat SEO strategies. We have a track record of delivering measurable results for 150+ clients across Nepal.

home.q: What is the difference between Local SEO and regular SEO?
home.a: Regular SEO focuses on ranking for broad, nationwide keywords. Local SEO is specifically designed to help your business appear in local search results and Google Maps when people search for services in your city. For example, 'best restaurant in Kathmandu' or 'hotel near Pokhara lake'. If you have a physical location or serve a specific area in Nepal, Local SEO is essential.

seo.q: What is included in full SEO services in Nepal?
seo.a: Our full 360° SEO service includes Technical SEO (crawlability, speed, Core Web Vitals), On-Page SEO (semantic content, heading tags, meta data), Off-Page Link Building (high-DA backlinks), Local SEO (Google Business Profile & Maps), and AI Search Engine Optimization (GEO & AEO).

seo.q: Why is Technical SEO critical for Nepal websites?
seo.a: Technical SEO ensures Google crawlers can easily index and understand your website structure. It resolves mobile usability issues, broken links, canonical duplicate issues, slow loading speeds, and missing JSON-LD schema markup.

seo.q: Do you provide location-based SEO services across Nepal cities?
seo.a: Yes! We provide full location-targeted SEO services for Kathmandu, Pokhara, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur, Biratnagar, Chitwan, Butwal, Dharan, and across Nepal.

seo.q: How does SEO differ from GEO and AEO?
seo.a: Traditional SEO focuses on keyword rankings on Google's search result pages. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) focus on getting your business cited as the direct answer inside AI tools like ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude.

local-seo.q: What is Local SEO and how does it work in Nepal?
local-seo.a: Local SEO is the process of optimizing your online presence to attract more business from relevant local searches. This includes optimizing your Google Business Profile, building local citations, getting reviews, and creating locally-relevant content. In Nepal, Local SEO is especially powerful for businesses targeting customers in specific cities like Kathmandu, Pokhara, or Lalitpur.

local-seo.q: How do you optimize Google Business Profile for Nepal businesses?
local-seo.a: We optimize every element of your Google Business Profile including: complete business information with accurate NAP (Name, Address, Phone), selecting the right business categories, adding high-quality photos, creating Google Posts regularly, managing Q&A, and implementing a review generation strategy to build your rating.

local-seo.q: How quickly will my business appear in Google Maps?
local-seo.a: With proper optimization, we typically see Google Maps improvements within 4-8 weeks. Full ranking improvements for competitive 'near me' searches usually take 3-6 months of consistent effort.

local-seo.q: Do you provide Local SEO services across all cities in Nepal?
local-seo.a: Yes! We provide Local SEO services in Kathmandu, Pokhara, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur, Biratnagar, Chitwan, Butwal, Dharan, and all other major cities in Nepal. We create city-specific strategies tailored to each local market.

local-seo.q: What is NAP consistency and why does it matter?
local-seo.a: NAP stands for Name, Address, and Phone number. Consistency of your NAP information across all online directories (Google, Facebook, Yellow Pages, etc.) is a critical Local SEO ranking factor. Inconsistent NAP data confuses Google and can hurt your local rankings.

ecommerce-seo.q: Why is SEO important for my e-commerce store in Nepal?
ecommerce-seo.a: E-commerce SEO drives sustainable, free organic traffic to your online store. Unlike paid ads that stop the moment you stop paying, SEO builds long-term visibility. For Nepal e-commerce businesses, ranking for product searches means customers find you naturally — leading to higher trust and better conversion rates.

ecommerce-seo.q: How do you optimize product pages for SEO?
ecommerce-seo.a: We optimize product pages by: writing unique, keyword-rich product titles and descriptions, optimizing product images with descriptive alt text, implementing Product schema markup so Google can show rich snippets (price, availability, ratings), improving page load speed, and creating a logical internal linking structure between related products.

ecommerce-seo.q: Can you help with Shopify, WooCommerce, or custom e-commerce stores?
ecommerce-seo.a: Absolutely! We have experience with all major e-commerce platforms including Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, and custom-built stores. Our technical SEO approach is platform-agnostic — we adapt our strategy to whatever platform your store runs on.

ecommerce-seo.q: How do you handle duplicate content on e-commerce sites?
ecommerce-seo.a: Duplicate content is a common challenge for e-commerce sites with multiple product variants. We address this through canonical tags to point to the preferred URL, no-indexing of filter/sort pages, unique product descriptions (no copying from manufacturers), and proper URL structure to avoid parameter-based duplicates.

ecommerce-seo.q: Do you provide e-commerce SEO services in specific cities in Nepal?
ecommerce-seo.a: Yes, we provide e-commerce SEO for businesses in Kathmandu, Pokhara, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur, Biratnagar, Chitwan, Butwal, Dharan, and nationwide in Nepal. Whether you're a local store or sell nationwide, we tailor the strategy accordingly.

link-building.q: What is link building and why is it important for SEO?
link-building.a: Link building is the process of acquiring hyperlinks from other websites to yours. Google views backlinks as 'votes of confidence' — the more high-quality websites that link to you, the more authoritative Google considers your site to be. Strong backlink profiles directly correlate with higher search rankings.

link-building.q: What types of link building do you do?
link-building.a: We use only white-hat link building techniques including: guest post placements on high-DA websites, broken link building, resource page link building, digital PR and brand mentions, competitor backlink replication, and niche-relevant directory submissions. We never use spammy or black-hat methods that could get your site penalized.

link-building.q: What Domain Authority (DA) links do you target?
link-building.a: We focus on acquiring links from websites with DA 30 and above. The quality and relevance of the linking website matters far more than quantity. A single link from a highly authoritative, niche-relevant website is worth more than 100 links from low-quality sites.

link-building.q: How many backlinks will I get per month?
link-building.a: The number depends on your package, but typically ranges from 5-15 high-quality links per month. We prioritize quality over quantity. Each link we build is manually acquired from real, relevant websites — not automated or purchased from link farms.

link-building.q: Can link building hurt my website?
link-building.a: Good link building (white-hat) never hurts your website. However, black-hat link building (buying links, PBNs, spammy directories) can lead to Google penalties. We exclusively use ethical, Google-compliant link building methods that are safe and effective for long-term growth.

geo-aeo.a: GEO is the practice of optimizing your brand, content, and digital footprint so generative AI models like ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude feature and recommend your business when users ask AI search questions.

AEO focuses on structuring website content into clear Q&A formats and semantic entities so answer engines (like Google SGE/Overviews, ChatGPT, and voice assistants) can easily extract your answers as direct solutions.

geo-aeo.q: Are there city-specific pages for GEO & AEO?
geo-aeo.a: No. GEO & AEO strategies target LLM training datasets, knowledge graphs, and nationwide digital entity presence in Nepal as a whole, rather than localized city landing pages.

geo-aeo.q: How do you measure GEO & AEO success?
geo-aeo.a: We monitor prompt recommendation rates, AI citation appearances, referral traffic from AI engines (e.g. perplexity.ai, chatgpt.com), and brand entity inclusion in Google Knowledge Graphs.
